display_long_description:
Airport Security Simulator is an immersive VR experience where you take on the role of an airport security officer responsible for protecting the airport and ensuring passenger safety.

Every passenger must pass through your checkpoint before boarding their flight. Carefully verify documents, scan passengers for suspicious items, inspect luggage, and monitor health vitals to detect potential threats or medical risks.

Your job is to ensure that only safe and authorized travelers are allowed to continue their journey.

✈️ Experience the Full Airport Security Process

Passengers will go through multiple stages of inspection, and every step requires your attention and decision-making skills.

🛂 Passport & Boarding Pass Check
Verify passenger identity and confirm their boarding pass before allowing them to proceed.

🔎 Passenger Body Scanner
Use a full body scanner to detect hidden or prohibited items.

💼 Luggage Inspection
Open briefcases and bags to inspect items and identify suspicious objects.

❤️ Health & Vital Monitoring
Check passenger vitals to identify medical emergencies or possible infections.

✅ Security Approval Decision
Make the final call — approve the passenger to travel or stop them from boarding.

👮 Can You Keep the Airport Safe?

As an airport security officer, every decision matters. A small mistake could allow a threat to pass through the checkpoint.

Stay alert, inspect carefully, and protect the airport.

Welcome to the Airport Security Simulator VR Game
